Summary

I translate real business problems into production AI systems, applying agentic orchestration, RAG, structured outputs, and responsible AI controls across the full stack, then stay accountable for what happens after go-live. Two decades across tech, data, and commercial operations in health, finance, sports, and consumer. Most recently I built ARCS from scratch: an AI-native decision-intelligence platform on Claude with an MCP server and agentic orchestration, running in production. I work end to end: frame the problem, choose the architecture, build the system, and keep improving it after the merge. I have strong opinions about when an agentic approach is appropriate versus deterministic automation or human review, and I apply that judgment in every client environment.
